note: A DOC MAPPING CAN INVERT WITH NOBODY NOTICING, because nothing checks prose. Migrating notes into windows/lab/CLAUDE.md, I re-derived two recorded claims instead of copying them and BOTH had rotted. (1) The calibration study-to-binary mapping was INVERTED: the note put gathering_calibration on census-of-the-meeting; today that binary reads the-census and the other two read both. A fixture refresh scoped by the stale mapping leaves a binary red, which is exactly the failure the note existed to prevent. (2) The number of tests a new lab metric reddens was 34 when measured on 2026-08-02; those same three binaries hold 46 test functions now. Both were written down as facts, both had a date only in the authors head, and neither had any check. RULE: re-derive a mapping by grep at the moment you need it, and prefer documenting the MECHANISM plus the grep over documenting the ANSWER. The CLAUDE.md entry now tells you to distrust its own mapping, which is the only honest form a fact like this can take.
